description: YouTube administration for your own channel. Actions: update_video(video_id, title?, description?, tags?, privacy?, category_id?), create_playlist(title, description?, privacy?), add_to_playlist(playlist_id, video_id, position?), reply_to_comment(comment_id, text). Destructive (confirm:true): remove_from_playlist(playlist_item_id), delete_comment(comment_id).

params.description: Action parameters; destructive actions also need confirm: true
